title: Marketing Plan
seo: AI assisted marketing plan for small business
meta: A clear quarterly marketing plan with goals, audiences, channels and a content calendar. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: A marketing plan for your next quarter
overview: We use AI tools to speed up research, and a person shapes the plan around your business. You tell us what you sell, who buys and what you want from the next three months. We return a plan with measurable goals, two or three core audiences, the channels worth your time and a simple budget split. Everything is written in plain English, with a calendar your team can follow, and a person on our side reviews every line before it reaches you.

pkgs.blurb: A one page plan with goals, audiences and channels.
A full quarter plan with a content calendar and budget split.
A plan with a competitor scan, test ideas and a review call.

faq: Is the plan written by a robot?

AI tools help us gather and sort ideas faster. A person on our team reads your answers, edits the plan, removes weak ideas and checks every claim. You receive something written for your business, not a generic template.
What do you need from me?

A short form about your products, customers, past marketing and budget. Access to analytics or ad accounts is optional and shared as a viewer, never by password. More facts make the plan more specific.
No. Marketing results depend on your offer, budget and timing, and we do not promise sales or rankings. We set goals with measures, so you can see what is working and change course early.
Will you carry out the plan too?
The plan is the deliverable, written so your team or another provider can follow it. If you want us to produce content or run campaigns, the other services on this page can be ordered separately.
